meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以操控浏览器完成网页操作:打开网址、点击元素、填写表单、截图、提取页面内容等。它会先获取页面元素清单,再按你的指令逐步执行并汇报结果。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude 打开网页、操作页面元素(点击、填表等)、截图或提取页面信息等时触发。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com 并截一张全页图
say.note: 会先打开页面,再把全页截图保存到文件。

say.text: 列出这个页面上所有按钮和输入框
say.note: 会生成带编号的可交互元素清单。

say.text: 在搜索框输入'天气'并点击搜索按钮
say.note: 会定位到对应元素并完成输入和点击。

howto.what_en: Claude can drive a browser to open URLs, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, and extract content. It first lists page elements, then follows your commands step by step.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want Claude to open pages, operate page elements (click, fill forms, etc.), or capture/extract page info.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and take a full-page screenshot.
say_en.note: Navigates first, then saves the screenshot.

say_en.text: List all buttons and input boxes on this page.
say_en.note: Produces a numbered list of interactive elements.

say_en.text: Type 'weather' in the search box and click Search.
say_en.note: Locates the elements and performs the action.
